interruption_work_scope: Observed interrupted runner interval plus resumed process wall. Lower bound; successful-trajectory training time excludes discarded work after the step-15360 checkpoint.

final_stage_readout_spectra.scope: Frozen TRAIN contexts; conditional within-branch centered affine logits. QR factors preserve nonzero singular values without a contexts-by-vocabulary matrix. Context rank/energy is not conditional information, useful-depth causality, learning rate, attainable quality or a frontier scaling law.

nonlinear_readout_containment.scope: Frozen native readout contract; affine head plus zero-output-weight tanh lift. Prediction containment and factual feature cotangent parity, not fit quality or optimizer-step parity. Extra gradient coordinates can alter global clipping and later Adam updates. No temporal-core shortcut.

forward_horizon_contract.scope: Frozen TRAIN prefix, first-time-held forced receiver intervention; actual downstream races and numerical memory replayed across detached factual windows. All future token inputs are observed causal inputs during continuation. No learned credit fit, quality gain or derivative of the full stochastic routing distribution claimed.

allocation.scope: TRAIN-only predictable layer allocation; tokens/heads uniform. Local probability-score proxy, not full-parameter variance or an efficiency result.

training_profile.scope: Nonoverlapping factual/alternative/evaluation core, readout, backward and AdamW calls. Timing includes instrumentation overhead; remaining process work includes data, audit allocation, diagnostics, checkpointing and setup. No FLOP or energy claim. Profile covers this process only after a resume.
